fact: Algeria's Finance Ministry announced the launch of the first phase of deployment of the integrated budget management system (SIGB), covering revenue and expenditure, in its customs, treasury and accounting, budget and tax directorates.

Finance Minister Laaziz Faid told the National People's Assembly that the Treasury services' information system was adapted and put into service for expenditure execution under the programme budget from 1 January 2023.

Faid said the Djibayatic tax system covered 40 centres, with 43 tax centres, 37 proximity centres and the large-enterprise directorate digitised as of February 2024, and the Moussahamatic portal was extended to 242 tax offices in 31 wilaya directorates by end-2023.
